example.install_guide: Copy the reviewed packages/dex-agent-plugin folder to ~/.codex/plugins/dex. Add or update ~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json so Dex is listed with source.path ./.codex/plugins/dex — that path is relative to the marketplace root (the home folder for a personal list), not the .agents/plugins folder. Restart the ChatGPT desktop app. Open Plugins, choose Dex (unreleased local build), install Dex, and review its hooks. Start a new Work chat, keep Work locally selected, and grant the Dex vault folder. If ChatGPT Work is already opened on this Dex checkout, the repo marketplace at .agents/plugins/marketplace.json can be used instead of the personal copy. ChatGPT on the web cannot use this local plugin for a local vault. Ubuntu Cloud is not this desktop journey.
example.vault_grant: Start a new Work chat, keep Work locally selected, and grant the Dex vault folder.
